quotes.title: HD 221287
quotes.card: HD 221287, named Poerava, is a star in the southern constellation of Tucana.
quotes.introduction: It has a yellow-white hue but is too faint to be viewed with the naked eye, having an apparent visual magnitude of 7.82.
